name: gizza-ai/pdf-compress
summary: Shrink a PDF by recompressing its streams.

tool.description: Shrink a PDF's file size by dropping unused objects and Flate-compressing its streams (content and images), losslessly — text and vector graphics are preserved exactly and already-compressed image data is kept as-is (it does not re-encode images to a lossier codec). Provide the PDF as either a URL or a `ref` to an uploaded PDF attachment.

url.description: Document URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.
